fields.title: Value columns
fields.description: This list contains the columns that are rotated into one single column.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Skip rows containing missing cells
fields.description: Skip all rows containing missing cells in the selected value column(s).

fields.title: Retained columns
fields.description: This list contains the columns which are duplicated by the number of selected value columns.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Enable hiliting
fields.description: Select if hiliting is enabled between input and output data.
